content.title: About
content.content: Soy nut butter is a spread made from roasted soy nuts that have a flavor and texture similar to traditional nut butters. It is rich in plant protein, healthy fats, and vitamins, making it suitable for vegans and those with nut allergies.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Soy nuts are roasted soybeans processed into a nut‑like paste.
Soy nut butter is often used as a substitute for peanut or almond butter in recipes.
The product is gluten‑free and fits a gluten‑free diet.
Soy nuts are high in isoflavones, which may support hormonal balance.
Compared with many nut butters, soy nut butter is usually more affordable.

items.title: Rich in plant protein
items.content: One tablespoon provides about 4 g of protein, helping maintain muscle mass.

items.title: Contains healthy mono‑ and polyunsaturated fats
items.content: These fats support heart health when part of a balanced diet.

items.title: Source of vitamin E
items.content: Vitamin E acts as an antioxidant that protects cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Contains isoflavones
items.content: Isoflavones may aid hormonal balance and bone health.

items.title: Low in sugar
items.content: Soy nut butter contains virtually no sugar, making it suitable for low‑carb diets.

items.title: Soy allergy
items.content: People allergic to soy may experience reactions ranging from mild to severe, including anaphylaxis.

items.title: Phytic acid content
items.content: Phytic acid can reduce the absorption of certain minerals if consumed in large amounts.

items.title: High calorie density
items.content: Like other spreads, soy nut butter is calorie‑dense, so portion control is advisable.

items.title: Genetically modified organisms (GMO)
items.content: Most soybeans are GMO; choose a non‑GMO labeled product if this is a concern.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Soy nut butter can be spread on toast, added to smoothies, sauces, baked goods, or used as a base for vegan desserts. It also mixes well into oatmeal, yogurt, or fruit bowls.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in an airtight jar in a cool, dry place away from direct light. For longer shelf life, keep it refrigerated to prevent fat oxidation. Discard if it develops a rancid smell.
